premises.statement: The combination of id, _fivetran_start, and _fivetran_end distinguishes every retained account history record requiring a distinct history_unique_key.
premises.evidence_of_dependence: md5(concat_ws('|', coalesce(cast(id as varchar), ''), coalesce(cast(_fivetran_start as varchar), ''), coalesce(cast(_fivetran_end as varchar), ''))) as history_unique_key; the edit removes the QUALIFY deduplication.
premises.reason: Retained records sharing these inputs would receive identical keys despite the contract's uniqueness constraint.

fewer.reason: Removing deduplication introduces one unestablished key-uniqueness premise; the source-column, timestamp interpretation, and null-id filtering premises are already recorded.
The explicit DECIMAL(18,2) cast implements the documented output type; other relevant funnel premises are already recorded.
